topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The reduced antenna efficiency (41%) affects the array factor, introducing interference patterns that decrease the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). This is due to increased sidelobes and backlobes caused by reduced gain, leading to a 10-20% increase in interference power. The decreased SNR reduces system capacity by 10-20%, requiring additional transmit power or coding gain to maintain reliable communication. Adaptive Coding and Modulation (ACM) can be employed to adapt to changing channel conditions and interference patterns, compensating for the reduced antenna efficiency.

Key points include the importance of considering power constraints in satellite systems, the trade-off between transmit power and noise temperature, and the impact of antenna gain on system capacity.
